build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that creates a ball-and-ramp physics puzzle scene with teeter-totter mechanics
create_cos_helper: create a helper function that computes the cosine of an angle given in degrees
add_scene_objects: create ramps, fulcrums, teeter bars, and a target using the PHYRE creator C.add API
update_task_relationships: update the task to define a TOUCHING spatial relationship between the ball and target jar
set_solution_tier: set the solution tier metadata to BALL for the generated PHYRE task
